translation: If the patient passes the days and is not purged in time, the heat cannot be discharged. Also, if one gets the disease without heat, but only with raving, restlessness, and agitation, and the spirit and speech do not correspond with the person, do not press it with fire, but only take one square-inch spoon of Wuling Powder (Five-Ingredient Poria Powder) mixed with water. (The Wuling Powder is what Zhongjing calls the Zhuling Powder; it is the one of five ingredients in the second volume, in the section on cold damage with wind stroke, in the Qianjin Yifang.) One should make him drink about one sheng of freshly drawn well water; if one and a half sheng, up to two sheng, is even better. Have him stick a finger into the throat to vomit, and the disease heals with the hand. If he does not vomit at once, this kind of disease is mostly not good; do not force water on him, for if the water stops it will bind below the heart. One should make him vomit with other medicines, all making them correspond; otherwise it is dangerous. If this disease is not urgent, and one does not vomit and resolve it with the Zhuling Powder, his death is nearly swift. One may also first vomit out the poisonous matter and needle with the method; this is even better.
